blocks.name: Yajirobe (wild long black hair, orange gi, katana at his hip)
blocks.notes: Cols 0 idle, 1 blink (up col 1 is an empty cell), 2-5 walk cycle. Black hair is #000000 like the baked shadow (#424242 hair highlights). The katana hilt is palette 'prop'. Shadow: the default 'strip' mode is used; it also takes a few black sandal-strap pixels where they touch the ellipse ('outline' mode was reviewed and gains nothing visible here).

blocks.name: Puar (blue flying cat)
blocks.notes: Always airborne: the baked shadow sits ~6px below the body. Col 0 hover, col 1 the same pose 1px lower (hover bob; no back-facing col 1), cols 2-5 swim-flying forward (body horizontal, tail trailing). Fur is palette 'hair', the cream face/belly 'skin'. 'baseline' pins the ground row to the shadow line so the hover gap survives ground alignment.

blocks.name: Oolong (pink pig, navy Mao suit)
blocks.notes: Cols 0 idle, 1 blink (up col 1 is an empty cell), 2-5 walk cycle. The white collar/cuffs and buttons are 'outfit2'.

blocks.name: Chiaotzu (white face, red cap, floating)
blocks.notes: Always floating (detached shadow ~6px below). Col 0 hover, col 1 hover 1px lower (bob; no back-facing col 1), col 2 the single glide pose he moves in (all four facings). His red cap and black hair are palette 'hair' (#000000 also draws his black trousers, whose highlight #424242 is 'outfit2'); the white face is 'skin'; green trim 'accent'. 'baseline' keeps the hover gap. Shadow: he floats, so the baked shadow is a separate ellipse below him and the default 'strip' mode removes it, together with the few black shoe pixels that touch it.
